implementation.note: Metal pixel tests cover model alpha/weighted/unweighted and display-particle sprite/mesh/trail/ribbon/graph, depth, fog and resize. Actual Metal/WebGL three-scene demo confirms host integration. Final integrated test gate tracked separately.

architecture.note: Shared AlphaMode/parseMaterialBlend maps material and FX authoring to gfx::BlendMode. Model rendering/import/export consume the same state; FX view adapter sets existing model material state.

native_api.note: Public AlphaMode, parseMaterialBlend and materialBlendMode expose weighted/unweighted state; ModelMaterialTrack.blend shares parser. Native pixel fixture invokes actual rendering and distinguishes both arithmetic modes.

skill.note: Existing owner recipe documents exact authoring route, shared semantics, example and verified backend limits.

mcp.note: Actual domain fx_set/get persisted authored fields, refused invalid alpha/display combination and retained original after reopen. Registry audit confirms declared tools. Material library modes separately exercised through alpha, not FX blend.

studio.note: Native Studio built and real Materials UI saved/reloaded both additive modes; screenshots and disk inspection retained. Direct library edits retain existing explicit MapDoc-undo limitation. Also verified FX model material authoring through Effects Set/Get. No new preview/undo claim.

inspector.note: Existing Materials property selector offers both additive modes and preserves selected values after save/reload in native Studio. Also verified FX model material authoring through Effects Set/Get. No new preview/undo claim.

persistence.note: Actual native Effects Set/Get saved castShadow false, additive model material and display-space additive emitter, with zero warnings. Invalid alpha+display was rejected; fresh MCP process read identical JSON after reopen and disk bytes were unchanged. Existing JSON operation panel, not graph canvas/preview or Undo acceptance. Shared material library save/reopen evidence is retained separately.

graphs.note: This feature changes fixed-function model material blend state, not a shader expression or particle graph node. Existing shared material owner is used; creating a second graph for blend enums would duplicate ownership. Particle graph blend-space acceptance is tracked by particle-display-blending.

performance.note: Scoped macOS Debug/Rosetta acceptance: three480-frame scenes plus two720-frame linear/display loads (expected1024particles). Post-warmup CPU block means below16.67ms, sampled completed GPU frames below16.67ms and process peakRSS below512MiB. Allocation review records reusable particle buffers and recurring callback-list allocation; no zero-allocation, p95, leak or cross-device claim.

dependencies.note: Uses existing gfx blend state, Renderer3D, model/particle owners and PRISMA resolve. No package or competing rendering pipeline added.

headless.note: Presentation blend state only; no server simulation or authoritative gameplay state is introduced. Parsing remains ordinary data code.

examples.note: Three ordinary material-effects scenes verified in actual Metal and WebGL captures: shadow switch, weighted/unweighted model addition, linear/display particles. No special demo runtime path. Publication pending.

documentation.note: Reference and existing owner skill describe field names, alpha/depth/color-space semantics, real example and verification limits.

publishing.note: Bilingual devlog includes real WebGL captures and three-scene demo link; verified Web output pinned in site/manifest.json. Main integration and actual publication pending.
